milestone_spec.label: PR 871 + Reorder
milestone_spec.description: PR 871 persistent kernel with KV-head-friendly persistent ordering.
milestone_spec.notes: Needs instrumented probes for delayed handoff and steady-state split timings.

pr871_reorder_steady_state_regions.label: PR 871 reorder steady-state region cycles
pr871_reorder_steady_state_regions.description: Reorder-specific clock probe for steady-state overlap using the same instrumented harness as PR 871 base.
pr871_reorder_steady_state_regions.notes: Shares the same instrumented harness as PR 871 base, differing only in persistent tile ordering.

pr871_reorder_scheduler_split.label: PR 871 reorder front-end split
pr871_reorder_scheduler_split.description: PR 871 reorder front-end split into barrier_wait(k_full), scheduler sync, and clear(acc_s).
pr871_reorder_scheduler_split.notes: Same probe as PR 871 base with reordered persistent tile traversal.

pr871_reorder_tail_split.label: PR 871 reorder tail split
pr871_reorder_tail_split.description: PR 871 reorder tail split after wait<0>: v_empty handoff and acc_s cast copy.
pr871_reorder_tail_split.notes: Same tail probe as PR 871 base with reordered persistent tile traversal.

pr871_reorder_core_split.label: PR 871 reorder detailed core split
pr871_reorder_core_split.description: Detailed reorder WG1 steady-state core split using the same instrumented harness as PR 871 base.
pr871_reorder_core_split.notes: Lets us compare QK/PV launch, preamble, and softmax-core pieces without the old merged labels.

pr871_reorder_total_cycle.label: PR 871 reorder steady-state total cycle

pr871_reorder_total_cycle.notes: Measures from pre-k_full wait to post-tail copy for n_idx > 0.
